assignments.node_id: שבא אצל תלמיד חכם ומספר לפניו כל לבו
assignments.node_text: שֶׁבָּא אֵצֶל תַּלְמִיד חָכָם וּמְסַפֵּר לְפָנָיו כָּל לִבּוֹ
assignments.reason: This is the act of verbal confession before a talmid chakham — the third and highest of the three approaches to the tzaddik. Its essential nature is the confession/repair mechanism (ודוי דברים), which is the central repair-act in Package 1. It IS confession, even though it PRODUCES inclusion in Ein Sof.

connected_to: שבא אצל תלמיד חכם ומספר לפניו כל לבו
assignments.package_label_en: Ein Sof: The Infinite Will Behind All Wills
assignments.reason: Being 'included in Ein Sof' is essentially an Ein Sof state — the person's yeshut is nullified and absorbed into the Infinite. Its essential nature is the experience of Ein Sof itself, not the confession that causes it.

Returning malkhut to Ein Sof is the core goal of the malkhut-restoration process. Its essential nature is the repair of malkhut — it describes malkhut's journey back to its source. The action is about malkhut, not about Ein Sof.

Destroying the good letter-combination of speech is a corruption of malkhut (= letters = speech). The 'tzeruf hatov shel hadibur' is essentially a malkhut concept — dibur/otiyot/tzeruf are all aspects of malkhut in this Torah. This is malkhut being damaged.

Building an evil letter-combination is the creation of corrupted malkhut. The tzeruf (letter-combination) is essentially malkhut/otiyot in corrupted form. This is the evil state of the letter-speech domain that Package 1 centers on.

assignments.node_id: מחמת אהבה שהקדוש ברוך הוא אוהב אותך
assignments.node_text: מֵחֲמַת אַהֲבָה שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ - בָּרוּךְ - הוּא אוֹהֵב אוֹתְךָ
assignments.package_label_en: Unified Consciousness: Knowing Chesed and Din Are One
assignments.reason: God's love as the cause behind din is the very content of da'at in this Torah — knowing that even din comes from love (אחד = אהבה). Its essential nature is the unity of love and judgment, which is the defining quality of Package 2 (da'at). The node אהבה is already in Package 2.

Moshe's humility (anvetanut) is the essential quality of the talmid chakham that enables atonement. In this Torah, humility = making oneself shirayim = bechina of Ayin = Moshe. The talmid chakham/Moshe/Ayin cluster is in Package 1, and humility is the defining characteristic of this cluster — it IS what makes Moshe capable of repairing malkhut.

Moshe's power to atone is functionally part of the talmid chakham's repair role. Atonement (כפרה) is the repair mechanism that restores malkhut — it describes what the talmid chakham DOES, which is the central action of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: העלה את המלכות מבין הסטרא אחרא
assignments.node_text: הֶעֱלָה אֶת הַמַּלְכוּת מִבֵּין הַסִּטְרָא אָחֳרָא
assignments.reason: Raising malkhut from the sitra achra is the quintessential malkhut-restoration act. Its essential nature is entirely about malkhut and its ascent from exile — the core theme of Package 1.

assignments.node_text: כְּשֶׁמִּתְוַדֶּה וִדּוּי דְּבָרִים לִפְנֵי תַּלְמִיד חָכָם
connected_to: התלמיד חכם מפריש לו דרך לפי שרש נשמתו
assignments.reason: This is an expanded form of ודוי דברים (already in Package 1) specifying it is done before the talmid chakham. Its essential nature is verbal confession — the primary repair mechanism of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: התלמיד חכם מפריש לו דרך לפי שרש נשמתו
assignments.node_text: הַתַּלְמִיד חָכָם מַדְרִיךְ אוֹתוֹ בְּדֶרֶךְ יָשָׁר לְפִי שֹׁרֶשׁ נִשְׁמָתוֹ
connected_to: יספר לפני התלמיד חכם, הינו ודוי דברים
assignments.reason: The talmid chakham guiding according to one's soul-root is the function of the talmid chakham — this is what the tzaddik/Moshe/פרשת דרכים cluster DOES. Its essential nature is the talmid chakham's role as guide, which is in Package 1.

assignments.node_id: יספר לפני התלמיד חכם, הינו ודוי דברים
assignments.node_text: וִיסַפֵּר לִפְנֵי הַתַּלְמִיד חָכָם, הַיְנוּ וִדּוּי דְּבָרִים
connected_to: התלמיד חכם מפריש לו דרך לפי שרש נשמתו
assignments.reason: Telling one's story before the talmid chakham IS vidui devarim, as the node text itself states ('haynu vidui devarim'). This is the confession/repair mechanism at the heart of Package 1.
Malkhut that has been lowered/degraded is malkhut in its exiled, damaged state — the very problem that Package 1 is about repairing. Its essential nature is malkhut itself, in its fallen condition.

assignments.package_label_en: Unified Consciousness: Knowing Chesed and Din Are One
assignments.reason: God's wrath (chamat melekh) is a manifestation of divine din — one of the two poles (chesed and din) whose unity constitutes da'at. The proof text (Proverbs 16:14) frames this as God's anger over malkhut being lowered, but the concept itself — divine wrath as a form of din — belongs to the da'at domain that unifies chesed and din.

assignments.node_id: כשמעלה בחינת מלכות דקדשה מהגלות מבין העכו"ם
assignments.node_text: כְּשֶׁמַּעֲלֶה בְּחִינַת מַלְכוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה מֵהַגָּלוּת מִבֵּין הָעֲכּוּ"ם
assignments.reason: Raising holy malkhut from exile among the nations is the definitive malkhut-restoration act. Its essential nature is entirely about malkhut and its redemption from galut — the central theme of Package 1.

connected_to: כשמעלה בחינת מלכות דקדשה מהגלות מבין העכו"ם
assignments.package_label_en: The Attainment of Knowing All Events Are for Good
assignments.reason: This is a variant form of the Package 4 dominant node 'כשאדם יודע שכל מארעותיו הם לטובתו'. Its essential nature is the personal experiential attainment of knowing all events are for one's good — the very definition of Package 4.

The letters (otiyot) exiting from one's bones describes the mechanism of confession releasing the engraved evil permutations. Otiyot are a bechina of malkhut in this Torah, and the bones-letters mechanism is the physical process of malkhut-repair through vidui. This is the malkhut/otiyot domain.

connected_to: יכול האדם, לשמע שבחו, ולא יבוא לו שום גדלות
assignments.package_label_en: Ein Sof: The Infinite Will Behind All Wills
assignments.reason: Nullification of all physical sensations and materiality (bitul kol hargashotav vechamriyutav) is the state of hitpashetut hagashmiyut — dissolving one's yeshut to be absorbed into Ein Sof. This is the essential nature of cleaving to the Infinite, not of malkhut-repair. The Torah teaches that Moshe's bitul is what allows him to connect to ratzon Ein Sof.

assignments.node_id: יכול האדם, לשמע שבחו, ולא יבוא לו שום גדלות
assignments.node_text: יָכוֹל הָאָדָם, לִשְׁמֹעַ שִׁבְחוֹ, וְלֹא יָבוֹא לוֹ שׁוּם גַּדְלוּת
assignments.reason: The ability to hear praise without pride is the practical expression of Moshe's humility — the quality that enables the talmid chakham to atone and repair malkhut. Its essential nature is the character trait of the tzaddik/talmid chakham that qualifies him for his role in Package 1.

connected_to: יש לו כח לפער פיו בצרופים רעים
assignments.reason: Blemishing malkhut is literally damage to malkhut — the core problem of Package 1. Its essential nature is malkhut in its damaged/corrupted state.

assignments.node_id: יש לו כח לפער פיו בצרופים רעים
assignments.node_text: יֵשׁ לוֹ כֹּחַ לִפְעֹר פִּיו בְּצֵרוּפִים רָעִים
assignments.reason: The power to open one's mouth in evil permutations (the Baal Peor concept) describes the corruption of speech/letters — which ARE malkhut in this Torah. Evil tzerufim are the corruption of the otiyot/dibur/malkhut domain.

connected_to: מבטלת המדות רעות הנמשכין משני היסודות: דומם צומח
assignments.reason: Seeing the tzaddik is the first of the three approaches to the tzaddik — a practical mechanism for malkhut-repair. Its essential nature is the act of approaching the tzaddik, which is the central repair pathway of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: מבטלת המדות רעות הנמשכין משני היסודות: דומם צומח
assignments.node_text: מְבַטֶּלֶת הַמִּדּוֹת רָעוֹת הַנִּמְשָׁכִין מִשְּׁנֵי הַיְּסוֹדוֹת: 'דּוֹמֵם' 'צוֹמֵחַ'
assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclinations Rooted in the Four Physical Elements
assignments.reason: The evil middot derived from domem and tzomea'ch are the content being nullified. Its essential nature is the evil middot/elements domain — it describes WHAT those middot are (bad traits from the four elements), not the mechanism that nullifies them. Domem and tzomea'ch are already in Package 6.

connected_to: מכניס בחינת הדבור של הלאו הזה שעבר בתוך הטמאה
assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclinations Rooted in the Four Physical Elements
assignments.reason: Committing a sin (aveirah) is the act of transgression that produces the evil effects on malkhut. Its essential nature is sin/evil action — the domain of evil middot and their expression. The aveirah comes FROM the evil middot of Package 6.

assignments.node_id: מכניס בחינת הדבור של הלאו הזה שעבר בתוך הטמאה
assignments.node_text: מַכְנִיס בְּחִינַת הַדִּבּוּר שֶׁל הַלָּאו הַזֶּה שֶׁעָבַר בְּתוֹךְ הַטֻּמְאָה
assignments.reason: Inserting the speech-aspect of a transgression into impurity describes malkhut/dibur being sent into exile among the nations. Its essential nature is about dibur/malkhut being corrupted and placed within tumah — the fall of malkhut that Package 1 is centered on repairing.
Malkhut being repaired is literally the goal-state of Package 1 — malkhut restored to its source. Its essential nature is malkhut itself in its repaired condition.

assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclinations Rooted in the Four Physical Elements
assignments.reason: One's sins (avonot) are the accumulated result of evil middot and the cause of malkhut's degradation. Their essential nature is the evil domain — sins are what the evil middot produce. They belong with the evil-elements package.

Wealth (becoming rich through tzedakah) is the practical result of giving charity to the talmid chakham. In this Torah, wealth is the opposite of the poverty that evil middot (devarim betelim, ga'avah) cause. Tzedakah is in Package 1 as a malkhut-repair mechanism, and the resultant wealth is the material blessing that flows from that repair.

connected_to: מן הנמנע, שלא יבוא לו איזה גדלות
assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclinations Rooted in the Four Physical Elements
assignments.reason: Hearing one's praise is a neutral circumstance — it is the trigger that leads to pride (ga'avah). Its essential nature is a situation that can lead to evil (gadlut/ga'avah). Since it is the cause of ga'avah (in Package 6), and ga'avah comes from the medaber element, this neutral trigger belongs in the evil-elements domain as the provocative circumstance.

assignments.node_id: מן הנמנע, שלא יבוא לו איזה גדלות
assignments.node_text: מִן הַנִּמְנָע, שֶׁלֹּא יָבוֹא לוֹ אֵיזֶה גַּדְלוּת
assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclinations Rooted in the Four Physical Elements
assignments.reason: The inevitability of gadlut (self-aggrandizement/pride) when hearing praise is a form of ga'avah — the evil middah from the medaber element. Its essential nature is pride/gadlut, which belongs in the evil-middot domain. Ga'avah is already in Package 6.

The 'sixty warriors' (shishim giborim, from Song of Songs 3:7) represent the sixty queens/kings (shishim hemah melakhot) — a bechina of malkhut. In the Rabba bar bar Chana parable, the sixty mechoza represent the rising of malkhut. The sixty warriors are the source of sustenance (parnasah) which flows from the restoration of malkhut.

Sustenance (parnasah) coming from the sixty warriors is a material blessing that flows from the repair of malkhut. In this Torah, poverty comes from evil middot (devarim betelim, ga'avah), and the rectification through tzedakah restores sustenance — this is the material dimension of malkhut's restoration.
Repairing and raising malkhut to its source is the defining goal-state of Package 1. Its essential nature is entirely about malkhut and its restoration.

An evil letter-combination engraved on one's bones is the state of corrupted malkhut/otiyot inscribed on the physical body. The tzeruf (letter-combination) = otiyot = malkhut. This is malkhut in its corrupted, embodied form — the condition that vidui devarim is designed to reverse.

The evil permutation taking vengeance on the person describes the punishment that comes from corrupted malkhut/otiyot. Its essential nature is the consequence of malkhut being in its fallen state — the evil tzeruf acts against the person. This is the malkhut-corruption domain.

assignments.package_label_en: Unified Consciousness: Knowing Chesed and Din Are One
assignments.reason: The 'reshimu' (imprint/trace) of the unity that remains after the ratzo vaShov is what illuminates da'at. The reshimu is essentially a da'at-concept — it is the residual awareness of divine unity (achdut) that carries over into consciousness. Achdut shel chesed ugvurah is already in Package 2.

connected_to: רשימו מראה לדעת, שידע שכלו טוב וכלו אחד
assignments.package_label_en: Ein Sof: The Infinite Will Behind All Wills
assignments.reason: The 'vaShov' (return) phase of ratzo vaShov is part of the process of cleaving to Ein Sof. The ratzo vaShov dynamic is essentially about the relationship between finite existence and Ein Sof — the return from the Infinite. Its essential nature is the Ein Sof cleaving process.

The speech of confession being formed from the released letters describes the rebuilding of malkhut dekedusha from the letters that were trapped in evil permutations. Dibur and vidui are both core concepts of Package 1 — this is the reconstruction of holy malkhut/speech.

connected_to: התלמיד חכם מפריש לו דרך לפי שרש נשמתו
assignments.reason: Being saved from all (the evil middot) is the culminating result of the three approaches to the tzaddik. Its essential nature is the complete salvation/repair that comes through the talmid chakham — the endpoint of the Package 1 repair process.

connected_to: נצול ממדות רעות של שני יסודות: חי מדבר
assignments.reason: Giving charity to a talmid chakham is the second of the three approaches to the tzaddik. Its essential nature is the tzedakah/repair-mechanism domain — tzedakah and עמוד השחר are already in Package 1 as repair mechanisms.

assignments.node_id: נצול ממדות רעות של שני יסודות: חי מדבר
assignments.node_text: נִצּוֹל מִמִּדּוֹת רָעוֹת שֶׁל שְׁנֵי יְסוֹדוֹת: 'חַי' 'מְדַבֵּר'
assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclinations Rooted in the Four Physical Elements
assignments.reason: Being saved from the evil middot of the chai and medaber elements refers to the evil middot domain. Its essential nature describes WHAT one is saved from — the evil middot of two of the four elements. Chai and medaber are already in Package 6.

assignments.package_label_en: Ein Sof: The Infinite Will Behind All Wills
assignments.reason: Cleaving (devekut) to Ein Sof is essentially an Ein Sof concept — the act of connecting to the Infinite. Its essential nature is about Ein Sof and the human relationship to it, which is the domain of Package 3.

Through the tzaddik — the tzaddik/talmid chakham is the agent of malkhut-repair in Package 1. This node describes the mechanism (the tzaddik) through which evil kingship is annulled. The tzaddik is already in Package 1.

The annulment of the nations' kingship and dominion is the reverse side of malkhut dekedusha rising — when holy malkhut is restored, the nations' false malkhut is annulled. Its essential nature is about malkhut (even the evil form being destroyed) and the restoration of divine sovereignty.

connected_to: נתקים (שם מ"ז): "כי מלך כל הארץ אלהים"
assignments.reason: Raising malkhut from among the nations is the quintessential malkhut-restoration act — essentially identical in nature to other malkhut-raising nodes in Package 1.

assignments.node_id: נתקים (שם מ"ז): "כי מלך כל הארץ אלהים"
assignments.node_text: נִתְקַיֵּם (שָׁם מ"ז): "כִּי מֶלֶךְ כָּל הָאָרֶץ אֱלֹהִים"
assignments.reason: The verse 'God is King of all the earth' being fulfilled is the end-state of malkhut's restoration — Elokim (= malkhut) becomes recognized as King over all. Its essential nature is the triumph of divine malkhut.

Drawing close to the tzaddikim is the umbrella mechanism encompassing all three approaches (seeing, giving tzedakah, confessing). Its essential nature is the pathway to the tzaddik — the central repair mechanism of Package 1.
Everything being repaired is the ultimate goal of the malkhut-restoration process. Its essential nature is the completed repair — the end-state of Package 1's tikkun.

assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclinations Rooted in the Four Physical Elements
assignments.reason: Idolatry (avodah zarah) is the evil consequence of malkhut being in exile — the nations' false gods are called 'Elokim' because they suck vitality from fallen malkhut. Its essential nature is the evil-domain counterpart of divine sovereignty. The Torah says the nations' idols are called by the divine name Elokim because malkhut has fallen to them.

assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclinations Rooted in the Four Physical Elements
assignments.reason: Poverty (aniyut) is the direct consequence of the evil middot of devarim betelim, lashon hara, and ga'avah. The Torah explicitly states that idle speech and pride cause poverty. Its essential nature is the material manifestation of evil middot — poverty IS what these sins produce. All three causes (ga'avah, devarim betelim) are in Package 6.

assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclinations Rooted in the Four Physical Elements
assignments.reason: Idle speech and lashon hara are evil middot from the chai/medaber elements. The node text itself says 'devarim betelim uleshon hara' — these are the evil speech patterns that derive from the four elements. Devarim betelim is already in Package 6.

assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclinations Rooted in the Four Physical Elements
assignments.reason: Turbid/impure blood is the physical cause of sadness and evil desires. In the Torah, the tzaddik's proximity is like salt that expels bad blood (damim ra'im). Its essential nature is the physical-elemental substrate of evil middot — the bodily source from which the domem/tzomea'ch evil traits arise.

assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclinations Rooted in the Four Physical Elements
assignments.reason: Sadness and evil desires are the two evil middot from domem and tzomea'ch respectively. The Torah explicitly maps עצבות to דומם and תאוות to צומח. These are core evil middot of Package 6.

Salt (melach) in this Torah represents the tzaddik ('brit melach olam' — a covenant of salt). The tzaddik as salt expels evil blood. 'Brit melach olam' is already in Package 1. Salt's essential nature here is the purifying agent wielded by the tzaddik — a repair mechanism.

Expelling evil blood is the purification action performed through proximity to the tzaddik (salt). Its essential nature is a repair/purification mechanism — the tzaddik's salt purges evil. This is part of the repair-pathway of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: רשימו מראה לדעת, שידע שכלו טוב וכלו אחד
assignments.node_text: הָרְשִׁימוּ מַרְאֶה לָדַעַת, שֶׁיֵּדַע שֶׁכֻּלּוֹ טוֹב וְכֻלּוֹ אֶחָד
assignments.package_label_en: Unified Consciousness: Knowing Chesed and Din Are One
assignments.reason: The reshimu (imprint) showing da'at — knowing everything is good and everything is one — is the essential definition of da'at in this Torah. 'Kulo tov vekulo echad' = achdut shel chesed ugvurah. This IS the content of Package 2: unified consciousness that all is one and good.

assignments.package_label_en: The Evil Inclinations Rooted in the Four Physical Elements
assignments.reason: Feeling a small impurity (tumah ketanah) that confuses one's prayer is the sheretz (vermin) in the whale's nostril from the parable. Its essential nature is tumah/impurity that infiltrates divine service — the same domain as שרץ and טמאה already in Package 6.

connected_to: תשובתו גורם, שגם אלו הרשעים נעשו כסא לקדשה
assignments.reason: The Israelite awakening in teshuvah is the initiating act of malkhut-repair. Teshuvah/vidui/confession is the central repair mechanism of Package 1. This is the person who performs the three approaches to the tzaddik that restore malkhut.
Tikkun malkhut (repairing kingship) is literally the name and defining concept of Package 1. It IS the repair of malkhut.

assignments.node_id: תשובתו גורם, שגם אלו הרשעים נעשו כסא לקדשה
assignments.node_text: תְּשׁוּבָתוֹ גּוֹרֵם, שֶׁגַּם אֵלּוּ הָרְשָׁעִים נַעֲשׂוּ כִּסֵּא לַקְּדֻשָּׁה
assignments.reason: Teshuvah causing even the wicked to become a throne for holiness is the ultimate transformation of evil into good — the culminating result of malkhut-repair. Its essential nature is the cosmic tikkun: evil becomes a base for kedusha. This is the triumphant endpoint of Package 1's restoration process.
